tickets.summary: FW-8102 failed its first test start amid recurrent starting issues; it started on retry with 22.8 V at rest and rated pressure, but dependable firewater availability is degraded and FW-8101 delivery is uncertain.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: A required first-attempt start already failed during testing. The later successful start and rated pressure confirm delivery once running but not reliable starting on demand.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure removes one safety-critical firewater pump. The N+1 partner cannot be fully credited because its later test showed 9.2 barg versus 11 barg design and flow was not measured; total firewater capability is therefore uncertain, not proven lost.
